ns2:course.label: Vocal Pedagogy
ns2:course.description: Explores applications of healthy voice instruction. This class has a flipped and blended learning design in which online work introduces the material and digital tools support training. The classroom is primarily interactive and integrative to address real-world scenarios. May be repeated in separate terms up to 6 hours. Prerequisite: Restricted to graduate Music majors.
